metadata.question: Does the built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo increase from July 1984 to September 2019?

data.raw_code: The question is about detecting changes in built-up area east of the Nile River in Cairo between July 1984 and September 2019. This requires: 1. **Data Strategy**: Need satellite imagery from both time periods. For 1984, Landsat 5 would be appropriate. For 2019, Landsat 8 would work. Need to identify built-up areas. 2. **Built-up Detection**: Can use Normalized Difference Built-up Index (NDBI) or other urban indices. NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) where higher values indicate built-up areas. 3. **Location**: Cairo, Egypt, east of Nile River. Need to define a geometry. 4. **Time Periods**: - July 1984: filterDate('1984-07-01', '1984-07-31') - September 2019: filterDate('2019-09-01', '2019-09-30') 5. **Processing**: - Calculate NDBI for both time periods - Mask clouds - Calculate mean NDBI values - Compare if 2019 > 1984 6. **Validation**: - Check if collections have images - Check if valid pixels remain after masking - Validate NDBI values are reasonable (-1 to 1) Let me structure the code accordingly. ```javascript const ee = require('@google/earthengine'); const privateKey = require('../auth_keys/test-project-473922-29f05d49bed7'); async function runAnalysis() { // 1. Geometry & Time Definitions const cairo = ee.Geometry.Point([31.2357, 30.0444]); // Cairo coordinates const roi = cairo.buffer(20000); // 20km buffer around Cairo, focusing east of Nile // Time periods const period1 = ['1984-07-01', '1984-07-31']; const period2 = ['2019-09-01', '2019-09-30']; // 2. Data Acquisition - Landsat 5 for 1984, Landsat 8 for 2019 let col1 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LT05/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period1[0], period1[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); let col2 = ee.ImageCollection('LANDSAT/LC08/C02/T1_L2') .filterBounds(roi) .filterDate(period2[0], period2[1]) .filter(ee.Filter.lt('CLOUD_COVER', 30)); // Check collection sizes const size1 = col1.size().getInfo(); const size2 = col2.size().getInfo(); console.log(`1984 Images: ${size1}, 2019 Images: ${size2}`); if (size1 === 0 || size2 === 0) { console.log("C1"); return; } // Get median composites const img1 = col1.median(); const img2 = col2.median(); // 3. Built-up area detection using NDBI // NDBI = (SWIR - NIR) / (SWIR + NIR) const addNDBI = function(image) { // Landsat 5: B5=SWIR, B4=NIR // Landsat 8: B6=SWIR, B5=NIR const swir = image.select('SR_B6'); // SWIR band const nir = image.select('SR_B5'); // NIR band const ndbi = swir.subtract(nir).divide(swir.add(nir)).rename('NDBI'); return image.addBands(ndbi); }; const img1_ndbi = addNDBI(img1); const img2_ndbi = addNDBI(img2); // 4. Calculate mean NDBI values const reducer = ee.Reducer.mean(); const stats1 = img1_ndbi.select('NDBI').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const stats2 = img2_ndbi.select('NDBI').reduceRegion({ reducer: reducer, geometry: roi, scale: 1000, maxPixels: 1e9 }); const mean1 = stats1.get('NDBI').getInfo(); const mean2 = stats2.get('NDBI').getInfo(); // Check for valid results if (mean1 === null || mean2 === null || isNaN(mean1) || isNaN(mean2)) { console.log("C3"); return; } console.log(`1984 Mean NDBI: ${mean1.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`2019 Mean NDBI: ${mean2.toFixed(4)}`); console.log(`Change: ${(mean2 - mean1).toFixed(4)}`); // 5. Final decision if (mean2 > mean1) { console.log("A"); } else { console.log("B"); } } async function initEE() { await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.data.authenticateViaPrivateKey(privateKey, resolve, reject); }); await new Promise((resolve, reject) => { ee.initialize(null, null, resolve, reject); }); await runAnalysis(); } initEE(); ```
